The cooling water system piping arrangement shall be clear, compact and suitable for construction. Pipe routing, valve locations, support arrangement, drain points, vent points and equipment interfaces shall facilitate on-site welding, installation, flushing, pressure testing and subsequent inspection.

01_Requirements

Valve locations and support arrangements shall facilitate on-site operation, installation and subsequent inspection. Sufficient space shall be provided on the valve operating side, and supports shall allow convenient fastening and adjustment.

01_Requirements
Drain points shall be provided at the lowest points of the piping and vent points at the highest points to facilitate system flushing and pressure testing.

冷却水系统管路布置应清楚、紧凑并便于施工。管路走向、阀门位置、支架布置、放水点、排气点和设备接口应便于现场焊接、安装、冲洗、压力试验和后续检查。
船厂建造方
管路布置图应经船级社审批，确保走向清晰、紧凑，无干涉。; 现场施工应满足焊接工艺评定要求，焊缝外观检验合格。; 管路安装后按设计压力1.5倍进行水压试验，保压时间不少于30分钟，无渗漏。
